Security auditing for code projects and LLM applications.

| Component | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Engine** | Python package with 7 deterministic scanner categories (~40 rules): secrets, prompt injection, PII, authentication, insecure output handling, dangerous code, and configuration. OWASP/CWE knowledge base, optional LLM enrichment, and safe auto-fixes. |
| **CLI** | `audit scan`, `audit explain`, `audit fix`, `audit info` — CI-friendly exit codes and JSON output. |
| **Dashboard** | Next.js web UI over the same CLI — scan local projects, browse findings with remediation detail, shared history. |
| **Demo** | Intentionally vulnerable LLM chatbot with planted findings for end-to-end testing. |

Fully functional offline; the LLM layer only adds deeper, code-specific remediation on top of the built-in knowledge base.

**Stack:** Python, Next.js, TypeScript, OWASP/CWE knowledge base.

Source: [Utkarsh736/audit](https://github.com/Utkarsh736/audit).
